name: service decomposition bounded context
rules: Treat a technical module or package as distinct from a service unless business responsibility, owned data and runtime independence are explicit.
Require contract-first communication and prohibit direct cross-service database or implementation coupling.
Keep owned, non-owned and projected data responsibilities distinguishable.
verification: Review candidate boundary, business capability, data ownership, communication paths and autonomy evidence.
Verify build, start, test, health, observability and deployment assumptions before claiming readiness.

provided_capabilities.description: Analyze service responsibility, data ownership and communication boundaries
